^2Multiplayer Only:^7 Killstreak kills count towards your next killstreaks. Only applies to killstreaks earned this life.

- Cannot killchain with killstreaks from another player's care package.
- Killchain kills don't help earn nukes.

perks/hustle_desc: Double the duration of Tactical Sprint. Increase crouch movement speed by 30%.

- Secondaries cannot be equipped.
